assembly_network_access: Final Mac assembly's urllib requests were explicitly disabled; every input came from the verified cache.
validation: Independent SHA-256 and byte-count checks for every source/application record and every tar entry, including notices and provenance; no source code/build scripts executed.
scope: Checks source-asset bytes, captured release inputs and provenance. Optional/dev Cargo sources are included without claiming all were linked. Source collection is separate from native binary/render validation; byte-identical rebuilding of upstream binaries is not claimed.
